title: cua-speedrun: Standardized Benchmarking of the Speed of Computer-Use Agents
title_zh: cua-speedrun：计算机使用智能体速度的标准化基准测试

paragraphs.en: Computer use agents (CUAs), which use graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete tasks on a computer, have recently surpassed human performance on many standard benchmarks, including difficult long-horizon tasks. Their capabilities are undoubtedly impressive, however, a key barrier to the widespread adoption and deployment of CUAs remains their speed and cost. Progress towards faster yet capable CUAs requires reliable evaluation of their speed, but many CUA benchmarks currently face a reproducibility crisis. Benchmarks are based on complex infrastructure with varying machine and container configurations that confound the evaluation of the execution speed of CUAs. Towards addressing this gap, we propose cua-speedrun , which introduces standardized infrastructure and task sets, with a focus on evaluating the speed and efficiency of CUAs. cua-speedrun uses a uniform virtual machine setup and execution pipeline, along with a common agent interface that enables single-agent implementations to operate seamlessly across different benchmarks. Across four different CUA benchmarks, we evaluate how reasoning effort, agent harnesses, and environment latency affect performance, speed, and cost. We find no single model family is optimal for all three; none of the open-weight models are on the frontier, and also, unintuitively, for some models increasing the reasoning effort can speed up task completion, while faster environment input-output can slow down overall task completion time. We also demonstrate that we can effectively reduce the evaluation task set of most CUA benchmarks without degrading overall statistical power, allowing for more efficient benchmarking and comparison. We believe cua-speedrun will enable structured progress towards fast, efficient CUAs, unlocking new real-world use cases and applications. All code, infrastructure, and analysis are available at cuaspeedrun.com .
paragraphs.zh: 计算机使用智能体（CUAs）通过图形用户界面（GUI）在计算机上完成任务，最近在许多标准基准测试中超越了人类的表现，包括复杂的长期任务。 它们的能力无疑令人印象深刻，然而，CUAs 广泛采用和部署的关键障碍仍然是其速度和成本。 要推动更快且能力更强的 CUAs 的发展，需要对其速度进行可靠的评估，但许多 CUA 基准测试目前正面临可重复性危机。 这些基准测试基于复杂的基础设施，其中机器和容器的配置各不相同，这干扰了对 CUAs 执行速度的评估。 为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 cua-speedrun，它引入了标准化的基础设施和任务集，专注于评估 CUAs 的速度和效率。cua-speedrun 使用统一的虚拟机设置和执行流程，以及通用的智能体接口，使单智能体实现能够跨不同基准测试无缝运行。 我们在四个不同的 CUA 基准测试中评估了推理努力、智能体框架和环境延迟如何影响性能、速度和成本。 我们发现没有单一模型系列能在所有三个指标上达到最优；任何开放权重的模型都未处于前沿，而且反直觉的是，对于某些模型，增加推理努力反而能加快任务完成速度，而更快的环境输入输出却可能延长整体任务完成时间。 我们还证明，在不降低整体统计效力的前提下，可以有效简化大多数 CUA 基准测试的任务集，从而实现更高效的基准测试和比较。 我们相信 cua-speedrun 将推动快速、高效 CUAs 的系统性发展，开启更多现实世界的使用场景和应用。 所有代码、基础设施和分析均可在 cuaspeedrun.com 获取。

paragraphs.en: Computer use agents (CUAs) are language model agents that interact with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to achieve a user-specified goal. CUAs operate over the same user interface as human users, enabling them to potentially automate a much wider variety of tasks without software-specific APIs.
paragraphs.zh: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）是语言模型智能体，它们通过与图形用户界面（GUI）交互来实现用户指定的目标。 CUA 与人类用户使用相同的用户界面，这使得它们无需依赖特定软件的 API，就有可能自动化更广泛的任务类型。

sents.en: Computer use agents (CUAs) are language model agents that interact with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to achieve a user-specified goal.

sents.en: CUAs operate over the same user interface as human users, enabling them to potentially automate a much wider variety of tasks without software-specific APIs.
sents.zh: CUA 与人类用户使用相同的用户界面，这使得它们无需依赖特定软件的 API，就有可能自动化更广泛的任务类型。

paragraphs.en: When measured in terms of success alone, recent model releases have pushed the capabilities of CUAs past human baselines. The best frontier models today achieve success metrics above human performance on popular CUA benchmarks: Qwen3.8-Max, Claude Mythos 5, GPT-5.5, and Gemini 3.6 Flash report successes ranging from 78.7% to 86.1% on OSWorld-Verified, far above the 72.4% human reference score ( Xie et al., 2024 ) . Across long-horizon benchmarks ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Jang et al., 2026b ) , frontier models have also demonstrated the ability to achieve strong performance on complex, long-horizon tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 如果仅从成功角度衡量，近期的模型发布已将CUA的能力推至超越人类基准水平。 当前最顶尖的前沿模型在热门CUA基准测试中的成功指标已超越人类表现：Qwen3.8-Max、Claude Mythos 5、GPT-5.5和Gemini 3.6 Flash在OSWorld-Verified上的成功率介于78.7%至86.1%之间，远高于人类的参考得分72.4%（Xie等，2024）。 在长期规划基准测试中（Aggarwal等，2026；Yuan等，2026；Jang等，2026b），前沿模型也展现出在复杂长期任务中实现卓越表现的能力。

paragraphs.en: Despite their strong performance, a major bottleneck for widespread adoption of current CUAs in practical settings is their speed and cost of deployment ( Abhyankar et al., 2025 ) . In particular, we believe that research on the speed and cost efficiency of CUAs has trailed capabilities research, in part due to the difficulty of fairly benchmarking speed and cost of different models in a consistent manner. Specifically, CUAs require complex infrastructure to run and evaluate. Different benchmarks use varying execution environments, ranging from local virtual machines to cloud-parallelized desktops ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Bonatti et al., 2025 ) . There are drastic differences in deployment setup, API interfaces, hyperparameter settings, agent harnesses, and even benchmark implementations across the community.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管当前CUA在性能方面表现强劲，但在实际环境中广泛采用它们的主要瓶颈之一，是其部署速度和成本（Abhyankar等，2025）。 尤其值得注意的是，我们认为关于CUA速度和成本效率的研究落后于能力研究，部分原因在于以一致的方式公平地评估不同模型的速度和成本十分困难。 具体而言，CUA的运行和评估需要复杂的基础设施支持。 不同的基准测试使用了多样的执行环境，从本地虚拟机到云端并行化的桌面系统（Xie等，2024；Bonatti等，2025）。 整个研究社区在部署配置、API接口、超参数设置、智能体框架乃至基准测试实现方面存在巨大差异。

paragraphs.en: Common agent interfaces. Existing CUA implementations are varied and do not always follow the optimal scaffolds. We implement a common agent interface for executing actions and interacting with the environment while allowing for portable agent harnesses and implementations. This allows a single agent implementation to work across different benchmarks. Our analysis also measures time differences due to factors such as the latency of closed-source models, which can vary by provider.

paragraphs.en: A maximally representative subset for fast and comparable evaluations. CUA benchmarks take a long time to run. We propose an energy minimization framework that selects a minimal representative subset of tasks within existing CUA benchmarks. This allows us to minimize end-to-end evaluation time while preserving the signal of the results, and maintain the relative ordering of agent performance. Our approach reduces evaluation time on OSWorld by 84.9% while maintaining high correlation with evals run on the full set.

paragraphs.en: We implement these features on cua-speedrun , and benchmark current frontier CUA models on several widely adopted CUA benchmarks, such as OSWorld-Verified ( Xie et al., 2024 ) and OSWorld 2.0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . In addition, we also perform evaluations and analysis on CUA-World ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) and MyPCBench ( Jang et al., 2026a ) , which test for long-horizon and personalized computer use, respectively. cua-speedrun allows us to maintain a live Pareto ranking of the most cost-effective, fastest, and most capable models. Through an extensive analysis of multiple cua-speedrun runs, we identify several interesting and applicable insights. Success alone hides large differences in speed: on OSWorld, the open-weight Kimi K3 (max reasoning) matches GPT-6 Astra (high), but takes 4.4 × 4.4\times longer per task, and none of the open-weight models we evaluate (Kimi K3, MiniMax M3, GLM-5V Turbo) lie on the performance–time or performance–cost Pareto frontier of any benchmarks. Speed also interacts with reasoning in unintuitive ways: raising reasoning effort can improve benchmark scores while reducing task completion time, since the added reasoning avoids repeated unsuccessful actions. Using a fast I/O system can also slow agents, as the models have not been trained to interact with desktops in different I/O speed configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 cua-speedrun 上实现了这些功能，并在多个广泛使用的 CUA 基准测试（例如 OSWorld-Verified (Xie et al., 2024) 和 OSWorld 2.0 (Yuan et al., 2026)）上对当前的前沿 CUA 模型进行了基准测试。 此外，我们还对 CUA-World (Aggarwal et al., 2026) 和 MyPCBench (Jang et al., 2026a) 进行了评估与分析，这两个基准分别用于测试长时程和个性化的计算机使用场景。cua-speedrun 使我们能够实时维护一个包含最具成本效益、最快且能力最强的模型的性能帕累托排名。 通过对多次 cua-speedrun 运行进行广泛分析，我们识别出若干有趣且具有实际应用的见解。 仅看成功结果会掩盖速度上的巨大差异：在 OSWorld 上，开源权重模型 Kimi K3（最大推理模式）的性能与 GPT-6 Astra（高配置）相当，但每项任务所需时间却长 4.4 倍；而且我们评估的所有开源权重模型（Kimi K3、MiniMax M3、GLM-5V Turbo）均未在任何基准测试中位于性能–时间或性能–成本的帕累托前沿上。 速度还与推理能力以非直观的方式相互作用：增加推理投入可能提升基准测试得分，同时缩短任务完成时间，因为额外的推理能够避免重复执行失败的操作。 使用高速 I/O 系统反而可能降低智能体的运行速度，因为这些模型尚未针对不同 I/O 速度配置下的桌面交互进行训练。

sents.en: We implement these features on cua-speedrun , and benchmark current frontier CUA models on several widely adopted CUA benchmarks, such as OSWorld-Verified ( Xie et al., 2024 ) and OSWorld 2.0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) .

sents.en: In addition, we also perform evaluations and analysis on CUA-World ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) and MyPCBench ( Jang et al., 2026a ) , which test for long-horizon and personalized computer use, respectively. cua-speedrun allows us to maintain a live Pareto ranking of the most cost-effective, fastest, and most capable models.
sents.zh: 此外，我们还对 CUA-World (Aggarwal et al., 2026) 和 MyPCBench (Jang et al., 2026a) 进行了评估与分析，这两个基准分别用于测试长时程和个性化的计算机使用场景。cua-speedrun 使我们能够实时维护一个包含最具成本效益、最快且能力最强的模型的性能帕累托排名。

sents.en: Through an extensive analysis of multiple cua-speedrun runs, we identify several interesting and applicable insights.
sents.zh: 通过对多次 cua-speedrun 运行进行广泛分析，我们识别出若干有趣且具有实际应用的见解。

sents.en: Success alone hides large differences in speed: on OSWorld, the open-weight Kimi K3 (max reasoning) matches GPT-6 Astra (high), but takes 4.4 × 4.4\times longer per task, and none of the open-weight models we evaluate (Kimi K3, MiniMax M3, GLM-5V Turbo) lie on the performance–time or performance–cost Pareto frontier of any benchmarks.
sents.zh: 仅看成功结果会掩盖速度上的巨大差异：在 OSWorld 上，开源权重模型 Kimi K3（最大推理模式）的性能与 GPT-6 Astra（高配置）相当，但每项任务所需时间却长 4.4 倍；而且我们评估的所有开源权重模型（Kimi K3、MiniMax M3、GLM-5V Turbo）均未在任何基准测试中位于性能–时间或性能–成本的帕累托前沿上。

sents.en: Speed also interacts with reasoning in unintuitive ways: raising reasoning effort can improve benchmark scores while reducing task completion time, since the added reasoning avoids repeated unsuccessful actions.
sents.zh: 速度还与推理能力以非直观的方式相互作用：增加推理投入可能提升基准测试得分，同时缩短任务完成时间，因为额外的推理能够避免重复执行失败的操作。

sents.en: Using a fast I/O system can also slow agents, as the models have not been trained to interact with desktops in different I/O speed configurations.
sents.zh: 使用高速 I/O 系统反而可能降低智能体的运行速度，因为这些模型尚未针对不同 I/O 速度配置下的桌面交互进行训练。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we describe our approach to address the aforementioned challenges with benchmarking CUAs. We base our techniques to improve CUA benchmarking on standardizing measurements and infrastructure (Sec. 2.1 ), selecting representative tasks instead of running entire benchmarks (Sec. 2.2 ), and building infrastructure that executes and times every agent consistently (Sec. 2.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们阐述了我们应对上述 CUAs 基准测试挑战的方法。 我们改进 CUA 基准测试的技术基于以下方面：标准化测量和基础设施（第 2.1 节）、选择代表性任务而非运行整个基准测试（第 2.2 节），以及构建能够一致执行和计时每个智能体的基础设施（第 2.3 节）。

sents.en: In this section, we describe our approach to address the aforementioned challenges with benchmarking CUAs.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们阐述了我们应对上述 CUAs 基准测试挑战的方法。

sents.en: We base our techniques to improve CUA benchmarking on standardizing measurements and infrastructure (Sec. 2.1 ), selecting representative tasks instead of running entire benchmarks (Sec. 2.2 ), and building infrastructure that executes and times every agent consistently (Sec. 2.3 ).
sents.zh: 我们改进 CUA 基准测试的技术基于以下方面：标准化测量和基础设施（第 2.1 节）、选择代表性任务而非运行整个基准测试（第 2.2 节），以及构建能够一致执行和计时每个智能体的基础设施（第 2.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Standardizing computer-use evaluations requires invariance across four different dimensions: (1) the agent, driven by a large-language-model; (2) the benchmark, which determines what an agent must accomplish; (3) the environment infrastructure, which is responsible for managing VMs, the environment lifecycle, and action/observation contracts; and (4) the agent loop, which determines how the model interacts with the infrastructure. Many computer-use evaluations often make different choices for these four components, making it difficult to study them independently. For example, adopting a new model may introduce a benchmark-specific action loop, or adopting a new benchmark requires changes to the agent or infrastructure. The goal of our setup is to ensure the decoupling of benchmarks from infrastructure from agent design, in order to ensure fair and independent evaluation across these four dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 标准化计算机使用评估需要在四个不同维度上保持一致性：(1) 由大型语言模型驱动的智能体；(2) 决定智能体必须完成什么任务的基准测试；(3) 负责管理虚拟机、环境生命周期以及动作/观察契约的环境基础设施；以及 (4) 决定模型如何与环境基础设施交互的智能体循环。 许多计算机使用评估往往在这四个组件上做出不同选择，这使得独立研究它们变得困难。 例如，采用新模型可能会引入特定的基准测试动作循环，而采用新的基准测试则可能需要对智能体或环境基础设施进行调整。 我们这套设置的目标是确保基准测试、环境基础设施和智能体设计之间的解耦，从而在这四个维度上实现公平且独立的评估。

paragraphs.en: Following prior computer-use benchmarks, each task specifies an initial desktop state, a natural-language instruction, and a verifier, either a programmatic check or an LLM judge, that scores the agent’s trajectory and final state. Agents observe screenshots of the desktop and act through keyboard and mouse actions; Appendix J.1 gives the formal definition. Comparisons between agents hold the benchmark and infrastructure fixed, and similarly comparisons across benchmarks fix agent and infrastructure, so each change behaves as a clean ablation.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循先前的计算机使用基准测试，每个任务都指定了一个初始桌面状态、一条自然语言指令以及一个验证器——该验证器可以是程序检查，也可以是大型语言模型（LLM）裁判，用于对智能体的执行轨迹和最终状态进行评分。 智能体通过观察桌面截图并执行键盘和鼠标操作来完成任务；附录 J.1 提供了其正式定义。 在智能体之间的比较中，基准测试和基础设施保持不变；同样地，在不同基准测试之间的比较中，智能体和基础设施也保持不变，因此每次改动都相当于一次独立的消融分析。

paragraphs.en: For each task, our infrastructure starts measuring time when the instruction is given to the agent and stops when the agent terminates or reaches the task limit (steps taken, wall-time, or both). Environment provisioning, task setup, agent initialization, and verification occur outside of this interval. The infrastructure records the total task time and additionally separates it into the time spent executing environment operations and the time spent executing agent operations. Thus, the agent time can be fully attributed to the “speed” of the agent, regardless of any time needed to set up CUA evaluations. Additionally, we also log the total cost of model calls. In addition, infra failures are retried, while agent failures end the trajectory, which is then scored.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个任务，我们的基础设施在指令下达给智能体时开始计时，并在智能体终止或达到任务限制（已执行步骤、实际耗时或两者）时停止计时。 环境准备、任务设置、智能体初始化和验证均发生在此时间区间之外。 基础设施会记录总任务时间，并进一步将其拆分为执行环境操作所花费的时间与执行智能体操作所花费的时间。 因此，无论设置 CUA 评估需要多少时间，智能体的时间都可以完全归因于其“速度”。 此外，我们还会记录模型调用的总成本。 另外，基础设施故障会进行重试，而智能体故障则会导致轨迹终止，随后对该轨迹进行评分。

paragraphs.en: A full computer-use evaluation is often expensive because of long trajectories adding to API/GPU cost, and often requires overhead for managing virtual machines (VMs), adding substantial evaluation cost. For example, GPT-5.4 costs approximately $4000 on the CUA-World-Long benchmark ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) . We therefore ask the question: can we reduce the size of the benchmark needed for eval, while still capturing the success rate of the agents we evaluate on the full set? We want to choose a subset that keeps the individual agents’ scores similar to their full benchmark scores and preserves the ordering of agents’ performance.

paragraphs.en: We adapt the virtual machine runtime from Gym-Anything ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) to run task environments natively in Modal sandboxes. paragraphs.en: Standard computer-use runtimes typically take roughly 2–3 seconds from issuing an action to receiving an observation. This latency is dominated by a variety of elements, such as action execution, waiting for the application to respond, and networking. The delay incidentally gives the application time to process the action (e.g., open a menu), allowing the agent to observe its effect. We therefore follow this design for our main evaluations. However, we develop a fast I/O mode, FastCUA , by optimizing networking, action execution, and image processing latencies (see Appendix B ). FastCUA reduces action-to-observation latency to 2–28 ms, an improvement of more than an order of magnitude over typical runtimes. At this speed, a screenshot can be captured before the application has updated its UI in response to an action. We evaluate this setting to test whether lower infrastructure latency reduces overall wall time.
paragraphs.zh: 标准的计算机运行环境通常从发出动作到接收到观察结果大约需要 2–3 秒。 这种延迟主要由多种因素造成，例如动作执行、等待应用程序响应以及网络通信。 顺便一提，这种延迟给了应用程序处理该动作的时间（例如打开菜单），从而让智能体能够观察到其效果。 因此，我们在主要评估中遵循这一设计。 不过，我们通过优化网络通信、动作执行和图像处理的延迟，开发了一种快速 I/O 模式 FastCUA（参见附录 B）。 FastCUA 将动作到观察结果的延迟缩短至 2–28 毫秒，比典型运行环境提升了超过一个数量级。 在这种速度下，应用程序尚未根据某个动作更新其用户界面时，就已经可以捕获到屏幕截图。 我们评估这一设置，以测试较低的基础设施延迟是否能够有效减少总耗时。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 2 shows the performance–time and performance–cost Pareto frontiers on both benchmarks. On OSWorld, the high-performance end of the time frontier extends from Claude Opus 5 (low), with a score of 87.6% in 86 s, through GPT-6 Astra (low), with 90.8% in 90 s, to Astra (xhigh), with 91.6% in 127 s. Gemini 3.8 Flash (low) matches the highest score and takes almost the same time as GPT-6 Astra, but costs $0.11 rather than $0.71 per task. paragraphs.en: Fig. 3 compares Gemini 3 Flash Preview at different reasoning settings on OSWorld, keeping the model and harness fixed. Moving from low to medium effort improves the score from 33.6% to 57.6% while reducing mean task time from 492 s to 268 s. We diagnose this as follows: at lower reasoning effort, while the model generates fewer tokens (1,598 vs. 4,125 at medium effort), it takes substantially more steps (56.0 vs. 32.5), since most of its steps are suboptimal. For instance, the trajectories show repeated unsuccessful actions at low effort, such as repeatedly trying to enter spreadsheet text through key combinations instead of text entry. Counterintuitively, higher reasoning effort can therefore shorten the interaction enough to reduce total task time, even when it increases the number of generated tokens per step.
paragraphs.zh: 图3比较了在不同推理设置下 Gemini 3 Flash Preview 在 OSWorld 上的表现，其中模型和工具保持不变。 从低努力度切换到中等努力度后，得分从 33.6% 提升至 57.6%，同时平均任务时间从 492 秒缩短至 268 秒。 我们的分析如下：在较低的努力度下，虽然模型生成的词元较少（低努力度为 1,598，中等努力度为 4,125），但所需步骤却明显更多（56.0 步 vs. 32.5 步），因为其大多数步骤都并非最优。 例如，在低努力度的执行路径中，出现了重复的失败操作，比如反复尝试通过键盘组合键输入电子表格文本，而不是直接进行文本输入。 因此，反直觉的是，更高的推理努力度可能足以缩短交互时间，从而减少总任务时间，即使这会增加每一步生成的词元数量。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 compares reasoning settings within Gemini 3.8 Flash on each benchmark. On OSWorld, low and medium reasoning both score 91.6%, but medium increases mean task time from 127 s to 250 s and approximately doubles cost. However, the trend changes on OSWorld2: moving from low to medium improves performance from 35.3% to 59.9%. But increasing effort further to high adds only 0.2 percentage points while increasing time by 49% and cost by 72%. GPT-6 Astra shows a similar dependence on the benchmark: on OSWorld, medium effort is within 2 points of xhigh at 29% less time and 15% less cost, whereas on OSWorld2, high effort gains 7.8 points over medium for 10% more time. The useful reasoning setting therefore depends on the tasks as well as the model: additional reasoning can be valuable on one (harder) benchmark and unnecessary on another (simpler) benchmark.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 compares GPT-6 Astra (low) with the normal input-output mode and our faster input-output mode, FastCUA (Sec. 2.3 and Appendix B.3 ) across five seeds per setting. Interestingly, while the mean environment processing time falls from 12.68 s to 0.34 s per task, total task time increases from 89.5 s to 99.0 s. We also find that the number of steps per trajectory increases in FastCUA. This is because fast I/O can return screenshots before an application has updated its interface. For example, after opening Save As, the agent receives a screenshot without the dialog and requests another screenshot 5.8 s later, which shows it open. Although theoretically a model could account for such faster I/O by using appropriate wait times (e.g., 100 ms in this case) for the application to update, we find that current models are not able to optimally utilize this, resulting in much higher times.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 17 compares GPT-5.6 Luna through the direct-API agent and the Codex harness on OSWorld. At low effort, Codex improves the score from 61.8% to 75.6%, but increases mean task time from 74 s to 145 s. paragraphs.en: Based on the analysis above, we make the following suggestions for building efficient CUAs:
paragraphs.zh: 基于以上分析，我们为构建高效的CUA提出以下建议：

paragraphs.en: Choose a frontier configuration for the required performance and budget. No single configuration is best on every metric, and the frontier shifts across benchmarks (Figs. 2 and 6 ), so candidates should be measured on tasks that resemble the target workload.
paragraphs.zh: 根据所需性能和预算，选择一种前沿配置。 没有任何一种配置能在所有指标上表现最佳，且前沿配置会因基准测试而异（见图 2 和图 6），因此应在与目标工作负载相似的任务上对候选方案进行衡量。

sents.zh: 根据所需性能和预算，选择一种前沿配置。

sents.en: No single configuration is best on every metric, and the frontier shifts across benchmarks (Figs. 2 and 6 ), so candidates should be measured on tasks that resemble the target workload.
sents.zh: 没有任何一种配置能在所有指标上表现最佳，且前沿配置会因基准测试而异（见图 2 和图 6），因此应在与目标工作负载相似的任务上对候选方案进行衡量。

paragraphs.en: Tune reasoning effort rather than setting it to an extreme. Too little reasoning can lengthen trajectories, while too much can add time and cost without improving performance (Figs. 3 and 4 ). Start with low or medium effort and raise it only for a measured gain.
paragraphs.zh: 调整推理力度，而非将其设为极端值。 推理不足会延长轨迹，而过度推理则会增加时间和成本，却无法提升性能（图 3 和图 4）。 从低或中等力度开始，仅在能明确获益时再提高。

paragraphs.en: The first computer-use agent benchmarks used synthetic interfaces ( Liu et al., 2018 ; Yao et al., 2022 ) . Follow-up evaluations moved to self-hosted realistic website analogs ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ; Drouin et al., 2024 ) , static datasets of real live website tasks ( Deng et al., 2023 ) , and live-Internet evaluations ( He et al., 2024 ; Xue et al., 2025 ) . Live, dynamic desktop benchmarks such as OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) evaluate agents on real Linux desktops using programmatic verifiers, with WindowsAgentArena ( Bonatti et al., 2025 ) , macOSWorld ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , iOSWorld ( Jang et al., 2026c ) , and AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) extending coverage to other platforms and professional workflows. Recent benchmarks stress long horizons and scale, such as OSWorld 2.0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , CUA-World from Gym-Anything ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) , and Odysseys ( Jang et al., 2026b ) . Another emphasis has become personal assistant evaluations, including OpenClaw-style works such as ClawBench ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , WildClawBench ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , and MyPCBench ( Jang et al., 2026a ) , which evaluate personalized computer use and digital assistants. OSWorld-Human ( Abhyankar et al., 2025 ) measures agent latency on OSWorld and compares step counts against human reference trajectories, finding that agents take longer than humans.
paragraphs.zh: 最早期的计算机使用智能体基准测试采用了合成界面（Liu 等人，2018；Yao 等人，2022）。 后续评估转向了自托管的拟真网站模拟（Zhou 等人，2024；Koh 等人，2024；Drouin 等人，2024）、真实网站任务的静态数据集（Deng 等人，2023），以及实时互联网环境下的评估（He 等人，2024；Xue 等人，2025）。 像 OSWorld（Xie 等人，2024）这样的实时动态桌面基准测试，通过程序化验证器在真实的 Linux 桌面上对智能体进行评估，而 WindowsAgentArena（Bonatti 等人，2025）、macOSWorld（Yang 等人，2025）、iOSWorld（Jang 等人，2026c）和 AndroidWorld（Rawles 等人，2025）则将评估范围扩展到了其他平台和专业工作流程。 近期的基准测试强调长期任务规划和大规模场景，例如 OSWorld 2.0（Yuan 等人，2026）、来自 Gym-Anything 的 CUA-World（Aggarwal 等人，2026）以及 Odysseys（Jang 等人，2026b）。 另一个研究重点转向了个人助理评估，包括类似 OpenClaw 的作品，如 ClawBench（Zhang 等人，2026b）、WildClawBench（Ding 等人，2026）和 MyPCBench（Jang 等人，2026a），这些测试评估了个性化计算机使用与数字助理的能力。 OSWorld-Human（Abhyankar 等人，2025）测量了智能体在 OSWorld 中的延迟，并将其步骤数与人类参考轨迹进行了比较，发现智能体的执行时间比人类更长。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced cua-speedrun , a framework for evaluating the performance, speed, and cost of computer-use agents under standardized infrastructure. Our evaluations on OSWorld and OSWorld2 identify the performance–time and performance–cost Pareto frontiers and show how these change across benchmarks. We further find that more reasoning can reduce task time by avoiding repeated unsuccessful actions, while faster I/O can increase it through additional interaction. These results highlight the need to study reasoning and interaction together when developing faster agents. We hope cua-speedrun enables the community to improve both capability and efficiency, making computer-use agents more practical to deploy.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 cua-speedrun，一个用于在标准化基础设施下评估计算机使用智能体的性能、速度和成本的框架。 我们在 OSWorld 和 OSWorld2 上的评估确定了性能–时间和性能–成本的帕累托前沿，并展示了这些前沿在不同基准测试中的变化。 我们还发现，更多的推理可以通过避免重复的失败操作来减少任务时间，而更快的 I/O 则会因额外的交互而增加任务时间。 这些结果凸显了在开发更快速的智能体时，需要同时研究推理和交互的必要性。 我们希望 cua-speedrun 能够帮助社区提升能力与效率，使计算机使用智能体更具实际部署价值。

paragraphs.en: We run the agent and task environment in separate sandboxes. The environment contains the desktop, applications, and initial task state; the agent interacts with it through screenshot and action requests. Task initialization and verification remain independent of the agent, allowing the same agent implementation to run across benchmarks. When the agent terminates or reaches its limit, the benchmark’s verifier scores the trajectory or final environment state.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在独立的沙盒中运行智能体和任务环境。 环境包含桌面、应用程序和初始任务状态；智能体通过截图和动作请求与之交互。 任务的初始化和验证与智能体保持独立，因此相同的智能体实现可以在不同基准测试中运行。 当智能体终止或达到其限制时，基准测试的验证器会对轨迹或最终环境状态进行评分。

sents.en: We run the agent and task environment in separate sandboxes.
sents.zh: 我们在独立的沙盒中运行智能体和任务环境。

sents.en: The environment contains the desktop, applications, and initial task state; the agent interacts with it through screenshot and action requests.
sents.zh: 环境包含桌面、应用程序和初始任务状态；智能体通过截图和动作请求与之交互。

sents.en: Task initialization and verification remain independent of the agent, allowing the same agent implementation to run across benchmarks.
sents.zh: 任务的初始化和验证与智能体保持独立，因此相同的智能体实现可以在不同基准测试中运行。

sents.en: When the agent terminates or reaches its limit, the benchmark’s verifier scores the trajectory or final environment state.
sents.zh: 当智能体终止或达到其限制时，基准测试的验证器会对轨迹或最终环境状态进行评分。

paragraphs.en: We use Modal to host the sandboxes and adapt the environment runtime from Gym-Anything ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) . The environment measures task time and the time spent executing actions and returning observations, independently of the agent implementation. As in Sec. 2.1 , task preparation, agent initialization, and verification are excluded from task time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Modal 托管沙盒，并从 Gym-Anything（Aggarwal 等人，2026）中适配环境运行时。 该环境会测量任务时间以及执行动作和返回观察结果所花费的时间，且与智能体的实现方式无关。 与第 2.1 节一样，任务准备、智能体初始化和验证均不计入任务时间。

sents.en: We use Modal to host the sandboxes and adapt the environment runtime from Gym-Anything ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用 Modal 托管沙盒，并从 Gym-Anything（Aggarwal 等人，2026）中适配环境运行时。

sents.en: The environment measures task time and the time spent executing actions and returning observations, independently of the agent implementation.
sents.zh: 该环境会测量任务时间以及执行动作和返回观察结果所花费的时间，且与智能体的实现方式无关。

sents.en: As in Sec. 2.1 , task preparation, agent initialization, and verification are excluded from task time.
sents.zh: 与第 2.1 节一样，任务准备、智能体初始化和验证均不计入任务时间。

paragraphs.en: Agents access models through API endpoints or a self-hosted vLLM inference server ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) . We use L40S GPUs for self-hosted inference. The evaluation configuration specifies the compute resources, task limits, and number of concurrent agents. Model initialization and weight loading finish before task timing begins.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通过 API 端点或自托管的 vLLM 推理服务器访问模型（Kwon 等人，2023）。 我们使用 L40S GPU 进行自托管推理。 评估配置指定了计算资源、任务限制和并发智能体的数量。 模型初始化和权重加载在任务计时开始前完成。

sents.en: Agents access models through API endpoints or a self-hosted vLLM inference server ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 智能体通过 API 端点或自托管的 vLLM 推理服务器访问模型（Kwon 等人，2023）。

sents.en: We use L40S GPUs for self-hosted inference.
sents.zh: 我们使用 L40S GPU 进行自托管推理。

sents.en: The evaluation configuration specifies the compute resources, task limits, and number of concurrent agents.
sents.zh: 评估配置指定了计算资源、任务限制和并发智能体的数量。

sents.en: Model initialization and weight loading finish before task timing begins.
sents.zh: 模型初始化和权重加载在任务计时开始前完成。

paragraphs.en: We assign tasks to available agents and environments. Each task starts from a fresh environment state. Its clock starts after the agent and environment are ready and stops when the agent finishes or reaches its limit, excluding time waiting for an execution slot. Model servers reuse loaded weights across tasks. We record a trajectory for each task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将任务分配给可用的智能体和环境。 每个任务都从一个全新的环境状态开始。 在智能体与环境准备就绪后，其计时器才开始运行；当智能体完成任务或达到限制时计时器停止，等待执行槽的时间不计入其中。 模型服务器会在不同任务间重复使用已加载的权重。 我们为每个任务记录一条轨迹。

sents.en: We assign tasks to available agents and environments.
sents.zh: 我们将任务分配给可用的智能体和环境。

sents.en: Each task starts from a fresh environment state.
sents.zh: 每个任务都从一个全新的环境状态开始。

sents.en: Its clock starts after the agent and environment are ready and stops when the agent finishes or reaches its limit, excluding time waiting for an execution slot.
sents.zh: 在智能体与环境准备就绪后，其计时器才开始运行；当智能体完成任务或达到限制时计时器停止，等待执行槽的时间不计入其中。

sents.en: Model servers reuse loaded weights across tasks.
sents.zh: 模型服务器会在不同任务间重复使用已加载的权重。

sents.en: We record a trajectory for each task.
sents.zh: 我们为每个任务记录一条轨迹。

paragraphs.en: FastCUA, our Fast I/O implementation, reduces the time between issuing an action and receiving a screenshot. We encode screenshots in the background and combine action execution and screenshot delivery in a single request.
paragraphs.zh: FastCUA 是我们快速 I/O 实现方案，它能缩短发出动作指令与收到截图之间的时间间隔。 我们在后台对截图进行编码，并将动作执行与截图交付整合到单个请求中。

sents.en: FastCUA, our Fast I/O implementation, reduces the time between issuing an action and receiving a screenshot.
sents.zh: FastCUA 是我们快速 I/O 实现方案，它能缩短发出动作指令与收到截图之间的时间间隔。

sents.en: We encode screenshots in the background and combine action execution and screenshot delivery in a single request.
sents.zh: 我们在后台对截图进行编码，并将动作执行与截图交付整合到单个请求中。

paragraphs.en: We use QEMU’s D-Bus display interface to keep the current screen in memory and encode updated frames in the background. We use JPEG at quality 95 with no chroma subsampling and retain the full 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 QEMU 的 D-Bus 显示接口来将当前屏幕保留在内存中，并在后台对更新后的帧进行编码。 我们使用质量等级为 95 的 JPEG 格式，不进行色度子采样，并保留完整的 1920 × 1080 分辨率。

sents.en: We use QEMU’s D-Bus display interface to keep the current screen in memory and encode updated frames in the background.
sents.zh: 我们使用 QEMU 的 D-Bus 显示接口来将当前屏幕保留在内存中，并在后台对更新后的帧进行编码。

sents.en: We use JPEG at quality 95 with no chroma subsampling and retain the full 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 resolution.
sents.zh: 我们使用质量等级为 95 的 JPEG 格式，不进行色度子采样，并保留完整的 1920 × 1080 分辨率。

paragraphs.en: We execute the action and return its screenshot in one request, reusing the network connection across requests. A lightweight command client reduces per-action startup overhead. We also place agent and environment sandboxes in the same Modal region to reduce network latency. Fast I/O returns the screenshot as soon as action execution and image preparation finish. It can therefore return a screenshot before the application has updated its interface, as illustrated in Figure 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们执行操作，并在单个请求中返回其截图，从而在多个请求之间重复使用网络连接。 轻量级的命令客户端可减少每次操作的启动开销。 我们还将智能体和环境沙盒部署在同一 Modal 区域，以减少网络延迟。 快速的输入/输出可在操作执行和图像准备完成后立即返回截图。 因此，它可以在应用程序更新其界面之前返回截图，如图 5 所示。

sents.en: We execute the action and return its screenshot in one request, reusing the network connection across requests.
sents.zh: 我们执行操作，并在单个请求中返回其截图，从而在多个请求之间重复使用网络连接。

sents.en: A lightweight command client reduces per-action startup overhead.
sents.zh: 轻量级的命令客户端可减少每次操作的启动开销。

sents.en: We also place agent and environment sandboxes in the same Modal region to reduce network latency.
sents.zh: 我们还将智能体和环境沙盒部署在同一 Modal 区域，以减少网络延迟。

sents.en: Fast I/O returns the screenshot as soon as action execution and image preparation finish.
sents.zh: 快速的输入/输出可在操作执行和图像准备完成后立即返回截图。

sents.en: It can therefore return a screenshot before the application has updated its interface, as illustrated in Figure 5 .
sents.zh: 因此，它可以在应用程序更新其界面之前返回截图，如图 5 所示。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares Fast I/O with Gym-Anything ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) and OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) for mouse clicks, key presses, and text entry. Fast I/O takes 2.4–27.6 ms per call, compared to 2.5–3.5 s for the existing implementations. For example, a click takes 27.6 ms compared with 2.8 s with Gym-Anything, while typing 100 characters takes 15.0 ms compared with 3.5 s.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 比较了 Fast I/O 与 Gym-Anything（Aggarwal 等人，2026）和 OSWorld（Xie 等人，2024）在鼠标点击、按键和文本输入方面的表现。 Fast I/O 每次调用的耗时为 2.4–27.6 毫秒，而现有实现则需要 2.5–3.5 秒。 例如，一次点击仅需 27.6 毫秒，而 Gym-Anything 需要 2.8 秒；输入 100 个字符仅需 15.0 毫秒，而 Gym-Anything 则需要 3.5 秒。

sents.en: Table 1 compares Fast I/O with Gym-Anything ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) and OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) for mouse clicks, key presses, and text entry.
sents.zh: 表 1 比较了 Fast I/O 与 Gym-Anything（Aggarwal 等人，2026）和 OSWorld（Xie 等人，2024）在鼠标点击、按键和文本输入方面的表现。

sents.en: Fast I/O takes 2.4–27.6 ms per call, compared to 2.5–3.5 s for the existing implementations.
sents.zh: Fast I/O 每次调用的耗时为 2.4–27.6 毫秒，而现有实现则需要 2.5–3.5 秒。

paragraphs.en: We time each runtime’s native env.step(action) call, from issuing the action until the observation is returned. We test four actions on a 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 Ubuntu desktop: clicking the Activities button, pressing Escape, pressing Ctrl+U, and typing 100 ASCII characters into a terminal. The caller and VM run in the same Modal sandbox. OSWorld uses its Docker provider with screenshot observations; both baselines use their default waits and action implementations. Table 1 reports the median of 20 calls per action, without profiling. Setup, pauses between calls, and saving returned screenshots occur outside the timed interval.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每次运行时中 native.env.step(action) 调用的耗时进行计时，从发出动作开始，直到观察到结果返回为止。 我们在一个 1920 × 1080 的 Ubuntu 桌面上测试了四个动作：点击“活动”按钮、按下 Escape 键、按下 Ctrl+U 组合键，以及在终端中输入 100 个 ASCII 字符。 调用方和虚拟机运行在同一个 Modal 沙盒中。 OSWorld 使用其 Docker 提供商配合截图观察；两种基线方法均使用各自的默认等待时间和动作实现。 表 1 报告了每个动作 20 次调用的中位数，且未进行性能分析。 设置、调用之间的暂停以及保存返回的截图均发生在计时区间之外。

sents.en: We time each runtime’s native env.step(action) call, from issuing the action until the observation is returned.
sents.zh: 我们对每次运行时中 native.env.step(action) 调用的耗时进行计时，从发出动作开始，直到观察到结果返回为止。

sents.en: We test four actions on a 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 Ubuntu desktop: clicking the Activities button, pressing Escape, pressing Ctrl+U, and typing 100 ASCII characters into a terminal.
sents.zh: 我们在一个 1920 × 1080 的 Ubuntu 桌面上测试了四个动作：点击“活动”按钮、按下 Escape 键、按下 Ctrl+U 组合键，以及在终端中输入 100 个 ASCII 字符。

sents.en: The caller and VM run in the same Modal sandbox.
sents.zh: 调用方和虚拟机运行在同一个 Modal 沙盒中。

sents.zh: OSWorld 使用其 Docker 提供商配合截图观察；两种基线方法均使用各自的默认等待时间和动作实现。

sents.en: Table 1 reports the median of 20 calls per action, without profiling.
sents.zh: 表 1 报告了每个动作 20 次调用的中位数，且未进行性能分析。

sents.en: Setup, pauses between calls, and saving returned screenshots occur outside the timed interval.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 shows that fixed sleeps account for most of the baseline latency. Both implementations sleep for two seconds after an action, and Gym-Anything adds another 100 ms per step. Subtracting the two-second sleep leaves 804–1524 ms for Gym-Anything and 524–769 ms for OSWorld. Gym-Anything captures a PNG with FFmpeg, transfers it, and deletes the temporary file; typing also adds a 6 ms interval between characters. In OSWorld, most of the remaining time is spent in the action and screenshot requests, including processing inside the VM and communication.
paragraphs.zh: 表2显示，固定睡眠占据了基准延迟的大部分。 两种实现方式在执行动作后都会睡眠两秒，而 Gym-Anything 还会在每一步额外增加 100 毫秒。 减去两秒的睡眠时间后，Gym-Anything 剩余 804–1524 毫秒，OSWorld 剩余 524–769 毫秒。 Gym-Anything 使用 FFmpeg 捕获 PNG 图像、传输该图像并删除临时文件；输入文本时，每个字符之间还会增加 6 毫秒的间隔。 在 OSWorld 中，剩余时间的大部分消耗在动作和截图请求上，包括虚拟机内的处理和通信。

sents.en: Table 2 shows that fixed sleeps account for most of the baseline latency.
sents.zh: 表2显示，固定睡眠占据了基准延迟的大部分。

sents.en: Both implementations sleep for two seconds after an action, and Gym-Anything adds another 100 ms per step.
sents.zh: 两种实现方式在执行动作后都会睡眠两秒，而 Gym-Anything 还会在每一步额外增加 100 毫秒。

sents.zh: 在 OSWorld 中，剩余时间的大部分消耗在动作和截图请求上，包括虚拟机内的处理和通信。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 measures latency from the agent issuing a command to receiving the screenshot file, including communication between sandboxes. We place both sandboxes in New York and test the four actions on two OSWorld desktops, with 0.5 s and 8 s gaps between requests. All 80 timed commands complete in under 50 ms. Median times are 38.5 ms for a click, 12.8 ms for Escape, 13.6 ms for Ctrl+U, and 29.5 ms for typing 100 characters. Communication contributes 4.6–5.0 ms on average. Image preparation after the request takes 0.02–0.27 ms; encoding runs in the background. Clicks take longer because input execution includes a 25 ms interval between pressing and releasing the mouse button.
paragraphs.zh: 表3测量了从智能体发出命令到收到截图文件之间的延迟，包括沙盒之间的通信时间。 我们将两个沙盒都部署在纽约，并在两台OSWorld桌面上测试这四种操作，请求之间的间隔为0.5秒和8秒。 全部80条计时命令均在50毫秒内完成。 中位时间分别为：点击38.5毫秒、Esc键12.8毫秒、Ctrl+U组合键13.6毫秒，以及输入100个字符29.5毫秒。 通信平均贡献了4.6至5.0毫秒的延迟。 请求后的图像准备耗时0.02至0.27毫秒；编码在后台运行。 点击操作耗时更长，因为输入执行过程包含按下和释放鼠标按钮之间的25毫秒间隔。

sents.en: All 80 timed commands complete in under 50 ms.

paragraphs.en: We provide templates for direct model-API agents, Codex, Claude Code, and open-weight agents served through vLLM. Each template contains two files: init.py prepares dependencies and model serving, and agent.py implements the agent loop. Initialization finishes before task timing begins. Users can retain init.py and modify only the agent loop to test a new model, prompt, or interaction strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为直接调用模型 API 的智能体、Codex、Claude Code 以及通过 vLLM 提供的开放权重智能体提供了模板。 每个模板包含两个文件：init.py 用于准备依赖项和模型服务，而 agent.py 则实现了智能体循环。 初始化在任务计时开始前完成。 用户可以保留 init.py，仅修改智能体循环来测试新的模型、提示或交互策略。

paragraphs.en: Listing shows a minimal agent. The script receives the environment URL and task instruction as command-line arguments and uses the Computer client to request screenshots, execute actions, and end the task. In each iteration, choose_actions receives the instruction, screenshot, and interaction history. paragraphs.zh: 列表展示了一个最小化的智能体。 该脚本将环境 URL 和任务说明作为命令行参数接收，并使用 Computer 客户端请求屏幕截图、执行操作并结束任务。 在每次迭代中，choose_actions 会接收任务说明、屏幕截图和交互历史记录。 这个用户自定义函数会调用模型并返回一个动作列表；当智能体认为任务已完成时，则返回 None。 用户需要自行决定如何向模型呈现这些信息。

paragraphs.en: For example, an action list can contain {"mouse": {"left_click": [640, 400]}} followed by {"keyboard": {"text": "hello"}} . These two actions are executed in order within one step. Convenience methods such as click(640, 400) , type_text("hello") , and keys(["ctrl", "c"]) each submit a single action. The agent can execute several actions before requesting another screenshot. Calling done() ends the interaction; the benchmark’s verifier determines the score.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，一个动作列表可以包含 {"mouse": {"left_click": [640, 400]}}，随后是 {"keyboard": {"text": "hello"}}。 这两个动作在一个步骤内按顺序执行。 click(640, 400)、type_text("hello") 和 keys(["ctrl", "c"]) 等便捷方法各自提交一个单独的动作。 智能体可以在请求下一个屏幕截图之前执行多个动作。 调用 done() 会结束交互；基准测试的验证器将决定得分。

paragraphs.en: Figure 15 compares energy-based selection with a randomized baseline that samples tasks across difficulty levels. paragraphs.en: A task can fail because the model chooses an incorrect action or because the infrastructure executes a correct action incorrectly. We developed CUA-AutoDebug to distinguish these errors. A controlled desktop application records the keyboard and mouse inputs it receives, including modifier keys and typed text. We also check the resulting application state: a click should reach the intended target, a drag should move the object, and typed text should match the requested string. For shortcuts handled by the operating system, we record input events before they reach the application.

paragraphs.en: We define a computer-use task as x i = ( E i , s i 0 , p i , V i ) x_{i}=(E_{i},s_{i}^{0},p_{i},V_{i}) , where E i E_{i} is an interactive environment with initial state s i 0 s_{i}^{0} , p i p_{i} is a natural-language instruction, and V i V_{i} is a verification function. An agent π \pi receives p i p_{i} and a sequence of observations and produces computer actions until it terminates or reaches the task limit. This interaction produces a trajectory τ i \tau_{i} and final state s i T s_{i}^{T} , with score r i = V i ​ ( τ i , s i T ) r_{i}=V_{i}(\tau_{i},s_{i}^{T}) . paragraphs.en: We use each benchmark’s verification procedure. OSWorld and OSWorld2 score task completion with task-specific programmatic checks. paragraphs.en: Table 22 compares Astra xhigh with its standard batched actions and a restriction to one action between screenshots. Both settings score 91.62%, but the single-action setting takes 182.7 s per task compared with 126.8 s for batching. It executes fewer individual actions (16.50 versus 19.90), yet requires more action batches (16.50 versus 7.14) and generates more tokens (2,559 versus 2,060). We keep the model, reasoning effort, 50-task set, and configured limits fixed. To enforce the single-action restriction, we reject multi-action requests and prevent further actions until the agent retrieves a new screenshot, including actions issued in separate back-to-back requests.
paragraphs.zh: 表22将Astra xhigh与其标准的批量操作以及限制在截图之间仅执行一次操作的情况进行了比较。 两种设置的得分均为91.62%，但单次操作设置每任务需要182.7秒，而批量处理仅需126.8秒。 它执行的独立操作更少（16.50次对比19.90次），但却需要更多的操作批次（16.50次对比7.14次），并生成更多令牌（2,559个对比2,060个）。 我们保持模型、推理努力程度、50任务设置以及配置限制不变。 为强制执行单次操作限制，我们会拒绝多操作请求，并在智能体获取新截图前阻止进一步的操作，包括在连续单独请求中发出的操作。

paragraphs.en: We investigate whether a coding agent can find task-selection methods that better estimate a new model’s score on the full task set. The agent develops these methods using results from six models; we evaluate them on a seventh model whose results are withheld throughout the search.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究一个编码智能体能否找到任务选择方法，以更好地估计新模型在完整任务集上的得分。 该智能体利用六个模型的结果来开发这些方法；我们在第七个模型上对其进行评估，而该模型的结果在整个搜索过程中均未被使用。

sents.zh: 我们研究一个编码智能体能否找到任务选择方法，以更好地估计新模型在完整任务集上的得分。

sents.en: The agent develops these methods using results from six models; we evaluate them on a seventh model whose results are withheld throughout the search.
sents.zh: 该智能体利用六个模型的结果来开发这些方法；我们在第七个模型上对其进行评估，而该模型的结果在整个搜索过程中均未被使用。

paragraphs.en: We provide the coding agent with results from six models on 107 OSWorld2 tasks. It can modify both how the tasks are selected and how scores on the selected tasks are used to predict the full-set score. Each candidate method selects exactly 32 tasks. We evaluate it using six-fold leave-one-agent-out validation: five models are used to fit the method, and the sixth to measure prediction error. The agent receives only this validation error and can revise its method. We separately test each candidate on the seventh model after fitting to all six available models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为编码智能体提供了六个模型在 107 个 OSWorld2 任务上的结果。 它可以同时修改任务的选取方式，以及所选任务的得分如何用于预测完整数据集的得分。 每种候选方法都恰好选择 32 个任务。 我们采用六折“留一智能体”验证法对其进行评估：使用五个模型来拟合该方法，用第六个模型来衡量预测误差。 该智能体仅能接收到这一验证误差，并据此修改其方法。 在利用所有六个可用模型完成拟合后，我们对每种候选方法在第七个模型上分别进行测试。

paragraphs.en: Figure 18 compares validation and test error across 34 candidate methods. Validation error falls from 2.43 to 0.01 percentage points, while error on the held-out model changes from 3.90 to 4.00 percentage points. The search nearly eliminates validation error without improving the estimate for the new model. Validation errors guide repeated method selection, allowing the search to overfit these six models.
paragraphs.zh: 图 18 比较了 34 种候选方法在验证集和测试集上的误差。 验证集误差从 2.43 降至 0.01 个百分点，而预留模型上的误差则从 3.90 变为 4.00 个百分点。 该搜索过程几乎消除了验证集误差，但并未改善对新模型的估计。 验证集误差指导了方法的重复选择，使得搜索能够对这些六个模型进行过拟合。
